import_provenance.original_title: Continuous-time synthesis for Metric Interval Temporal Logic
import_provenance.original_statement: Is the Church synthesis problem decidable for MITL specifications over finitely variable signals on the nonnegative real line? Given a specification relating input and output signals, determine whether a causal operator can satisfy it for every input, with output at time t depending only on input up to t.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The authors settle MSO order specifications, not MITL’s metric constraints; this is their signal-operator synthesis model, rather than a differently parameterized timed-game model.
